mapper.sql: oi.id, oi.code, oi.order_name AS orderName, oi.create_date AS createDate, oi.remark, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, oi.pay_date AS payDate, oi.finish_date AS finishDate, oi.order_price AS orderPrice, oi.user_coupon_id AS userCouponId, oi.coupon_name AS couponName, COALESCE(oi.coupon_discount, 0) AS couponDiscount, oi.user_num AS userNum, oi.commodity_id AS commodityId, oi.user_id AS userId, oi.address_id AS addressId, COALESCE(oi.commodity_num, 1) AS commodityNum, COALESCE(oi.ticket_num, 0) AS ticketNum, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wta.remaining_num), 0) FROM water_ticket_account wta WHERE wta.user_id = oi.user_id AND wta.commodity_id = oi.commodity_id AND wta.status = 1 AND wta.expire_time > NOW() AND wta.remaining_num > 0) AS ticketRemaining, ci.`code` AS commodityCode, ci.`name`, ci.type, ci.images, ci.content, ci.on_put AS onPut, ui.user_name AS userName, ui.avatar AS avatar, ai.address, ai.`name` AS taskUserName, ai.phone, ct.type_name AS typeName

FROM order_info oi LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON ( ui.id = oi.user_id ) LEFT JOIN commodity_info ci ON ( ci.id = oi.commodity_id ) LEFT JOIN commodity_type ct ON ( ct.id = ci.`type` ) LEFT JOIN address_info ai ON ( ai.id = oi.address_id )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ui.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{orderInfo.userName},'%')
AND ci.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{orderInfo.commodityName},'%')
AND oi.order_status = #{orderInfo.orderStatus}
AND ci.type = #{orderInfo.type}
ORDER BY oi.create_date desc

SELECT
WHERE oi.user_id = #{userId} AND oi.order_status != 0 ORDER BY oi.create_date DESC, oi.id DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( spo.days, '%m-%d' ) AS days, COUNT( oi.`code` ) AS count, IFNULL( SUM( oi.order_price ), 0 ) AS orderPrice FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 0 DAY ) days UNION SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 1 DAY ) UNION SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 2 DAY ) UNION SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 3 DAY ) UNION SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 4 DAY ) UNION SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 5 DAY ) UNION SELECT DATE_SUB( curdate(), INTERVAL + 6 DAY )) spo LEFT JOIN order_info oi ON ( DATE_FORMAT( oi.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( spo.days, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AND oi.order_status IN (1, 3)) GROUP BY days ORDER BY days ASC

SELECT count( 1 ) AS orderNum, IFNULL( SUM( oi.order_price ), 0 ) AS orderPrice FROM order_info oi WHERE oi.order_status IN (1, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT( oi.create_date, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m' )

SELECT COUNT( oi.commodity_id ) AS orderNum, IFNULL( SUM( oi.order_price ), 0 ) AS orderPrice, ci.`name` FROM order_info oi LEFT JOIN commodity_info ci ON ( ci.id = oi.commodity_id ) WHERE oi.order_status IN (1, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT( oi.create_date, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m' ) GROUP BY oi.commodity_id

SELECT oi.id AS orderId, oi.commodity_num AS commodityNum, oi.ticket_num AS ticketNum, oi.order_price AS orderPrice, oi.finish_date AS finishDate, ci.id, ci.`name`, ci.images, ci.content, ci.price, oi.create_date, ci.on_put, ci.type, ui.user_name AS userName, ui.avatar as avatar FROM order_info oi LEFT JOIN commodity_info ci ON ( oi.commodity_id = ci.id ) LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON ( ui.id = oi.user_id ) WHERE oi.order_status = 0 AND oi.user_id = #{ userId }

SELECT oi.code AS orderCode, oi.id AS orderId, oi.create_date AS orderDate, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, oi.commodity_num AS commodityNum, oi.ticket_num AS ticketNum, oi.order_price AS orderPrice, oi.user_coupon_id AS userCouponId, oi.coupon_name AS couponName, COALESCE(oi.coupon_discount, 0) AS couponDiscount, oi.finish_date AS finishDate, ci.id, ci.`name`, ci.images, ci.content, ci.price, ci.create_date, ci.on_put, ci.type, ui.id AS userId, ui.user_name AS userName, ui.avatar as avatar, ai.address, ai.name AS takeUser, ai.phone FROM order_info oi LEFT JOIN commodity_info ci ON ( oi.commodity_id = ci.id ) LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON ( ui.id = oi.user_id ) LEFT JOIN address_info ai ON ( ai.id = oi.address_id ) WHERE oi.id in
#{id}

SELECT , oi.id AS orderId, oi.order_price AS price, eva.id AS evaluationStatus, eva.content AS evaluationContent
LEFT JOIN evaluation eva ON eva.order_id = oi.id WHERE oi.user_id = #{userId} AND oi.order_status != 0 ORDER BY oi.create_date DESC, oi.id DESC

select od.id, od.code, od.user_id AS userId, od.order_status AS orderStatus, od.create_date AS createDate, od.address_id AS addressId, ui.user_name AS userName, ui.avatar, ui.code as userCode, ai.address, ai.name as taskUserName from order_detail od left join user_info ui on (ui.id = od.user_id) left join address_info ai on (ai.id = od.address_id) where 1 = 1 AND od.code = #{orderCode} order by od.create_date desc
